limitations: The existing test stream is evaluated repeatedly during training. Treat it as development data, not an untouched final test.
This is the repo PFA preset, not an exact RegBench paper reproduction.

Protocol v2 common architecture set (proxy_tasks/common_set): every cs_ model shares one skeleton (pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU, untied head, PyTorch default init) and differs only in the sequence mixer; width/depth/heads are the task's v1 transformer's. Mixer internal widths are matched to +-10% of the transformer block parameters. v2 results are not comparable with v1 (different protocol_sha256).
Fixed zoology MQAR: vocab 8192, length 64, 8 KV pairs; train/validation generation seeds 123/2147483789. No separate final test split.

Historical harness_validation completed four models x three seeds (456,789,101112). Linear and gated attention did not reach 0.99 within 30 epochs; GQA-2 seed standard deviation was about 45 percentage points.
Historical pilots are not acceptance results. Sequence mixers must be causal and supply any position information internally.

cs_retnet uses the torch parallel form of retention (common_set.retention.retention_reference), not fla 0.3.1 chunk_retention as in the other tasks: fla needs torch>=2.5 and this task runs on the torch 2.2.2 runtime required by zoology. tests/test_common_set.py checks the two against each other on CUDA.

Self-implemented Jelassi et al. 2024 copy (format of sjelassi/transformers_ssm_copy@1188c47, not vendored). Train on lengths 5..50 packed into 220-token contexts; evaluate 256 fixed strings (seed 2147483647) per bin: id 5..50, ood 51..100, 101..200, 201..300. Metric is the mean string exact match over the three OOD bins; id and per-bin character accuracy are in history.json.

Exact match is teacher-forced argmax over the copied characters, which equals greedy-decoding exact match. Budget: 4000 steps, batch 32, AdamW lr 3e-4 wd 0.1, warmup 100 + linear decay. Models are far smaller than the paper (transformer 4 layers/width 256 Hard-ALiBi NoPE, LSTM 2x512, mamba 4x256 pure-torch scan).
Task ID is jelassi_copy because a proxy_tasks/copy package would shadow the Python standard library copy module. This is not mad_tsc (MAD selective copying).
cs_transformer and cs_gqa use RoPE like every other v2 task, not the v1 Hard-ALiBi NoPE transformer, so their length generalisation is not comparable with v1 transformer.

Sequential CIFAR-10 with a fixed seed-42 45000/5000 train/validation split, train-only normalization and no augmentation. Test is reserved for frozen candidates.
v2 mixers are causal (the v1 transformer is bidirectional); the head pools the time mean.

A reconstruction, not the authors' original training implementation.
Every cs_ model trains 10000 steps (the v1 transformer budget and the fixed 10001-step learning-rate schedule endpoint); v1's 500-step LSTM budget does not apply.
Only the repeatedly monitored ID prefix is scored here. Sparse/dense OOD evaluation must be reserved for frozen candidates. Zero observed errors does not establish universal correctness.
